title: God Calls Exactly Seven Things "Beautiful" — and Every One Is a Letting-Go
excerpt: The descriptor jamil appears seven times in the Quran and never lands on a face, a garden, or a possession. All seven modify an act of release — patience, pardon, dignified parting. In the Quran's vocabulary, beauty is the open hand.
seo_title: The Seven 'Beautiful' Things in the Quran (Jamil)
seo_description: The Arabic jamil describes seven things in the Quran — and every one is an act of release: beautiful patience, beautiful pardon, beautiful parting. A close reading of what the Quran calls beautiful.
